title: The ring, Wednesday
logline: Wednesday. The walk. The bluff path. Chloe's hand in her pocket the whole strip. Wood draws the pocket. The dog, thirteen, carried the last stretch; she takes a turn.

panels.composition: The bluff path above the beach, March wind. CHLOE, left hand in her coat pocket. WOOD. BARNABY walking, slow.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a woman with one hand in her coat pocket and a thin man walking a windy bluff path with an old dog moving slowly, no words

panels.composition: The pocket. The shape of a hand in it. That's the panel.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a coat pocket with the shape of a hand inside it, wind in the fabric, no words

panels.composition: The dog stopping. Chloe crouching, both hands out — the left one too, for a second, the dot in the wind — lifting him.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a woman crouching to lift an old dog with both hands on a windy path, a tiny dot on her left ring finger visible for a moment

panels.composition: Chloe carrying the dog along the bluff, from behind. Wood behind her. The dog's face over her shoulder, looking back at Wood. The hand under the dog; the dot hidden by fur.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a woman seen from behind carrying an old dog along a bluff path with the dog's face looking back over her shoulder at a thin man following, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The pocket. She carries him. The dot under the fur.
